limitations: Open state and labels reconstructed from current issue records and later issue events; deleted issues, renamed labels and external Projects statuses may be missing.
Closed issues are distinct issue IDs with a closure event during the period, even if reopened.
Deployments are GitHub deployment records created during the period; successful means a success status before the end; zero records does not exclude external deployment.
Commits are from current default branch history, by committer date; not a historical branch snapshot.
Dates are UTC; interval includes start and excludes end.
